name: Ricardo Vargas Mendoza
bio: Ricardo's journey into motorsport started with a childhood fascination for the Dakar Rally, fueled by tales of Peruvian drivers conquering the desert. He pursued a degree in Mechanical Engineering, specializing in aerodynamics, at the National University of Engineering in Lima. His career began at a small Peruvian racing team, where he quickly demonstrated a knack for innovative solutions within tight budgets. He transitioned to European racing after a decade, honing his skills in Formula 3 and GT racing before ultimately landing a role as Head of Aero. Ricardo believes that a strong aerodynamic package is the cornerstone of any successful racing team and constantly pushes his team to explore unconventional approaches. He's known for his calm demeanor under pressure and his ability to translate complex technical concepts into easily understandable terms for the drivers.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed back with slight recession at the temples
physical.description: Ricardo is a man of medium height with a sturdy build and a thoughtful expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with aerodynamic sketches.
Has a particular fondness for mate de coca, which he drinks throughout the day.
Uses racing metaphors in everyday conversations.
